tool_input.description: Confirm new tests' scenarios fail on the pre-fix scripts from HEAD
Run both new test scenarios against the pre-fix scripts from HEAD

result:
Changed `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh` and added `lib/common.sh`.

Details:
- **rotate.sh** — `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which starts at the KEEP-th line (1-based), so with exactly N archives it deleted one, and it was the newest. Now `tail -n +"$((keep + 1))"`, keeping the newest N.
- **verify.sh** — the archive name was split out of the sidecar content with `awk '{print $2}'`, so `my backup-….tar.gz` yielded `my` → "archive missing" → BAD/rc=2. The name is now the sidecar's own basename minus `.sha256` (only the digest is read from the content), and the digest comparison `[ $expected == $actual ]` is quoted (`[[ "$expected" == "$actual" ]]`).
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — holds the shared option-parsing block (vars, `is_uint`, `need_value`, the `while`/`case` loop, `--keep` validation) and `resolve_dir`, sourced by `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` after each defines its `usage`/`parse_local_option` hook. Both keep the same flags; `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — two new tests (one per bug); both fail on the pre-fix scripts and pass now. `bash tests/run_tests.sh`: all 8 tests pass.

Two throwaway helper scripts (`/tmp/smoke_rotate_verify.sh`, `/tmp/test_buggy_head.sh`) remain in /tmp — deleting them needed a permission prompt; say the word if you want them removed.
